book.title: oMwazi Mwinja gwa Yeesu Krisitu nk'oku LUUKA aguyandikaga

content: Yeesu na Zaakayo
Yeesu aliiri abalama kugerera omu gishagala ch'eYeeriko.
Mw'echo gishagala mwaliiri omuntu muguma oyirikwa Zaakayo. Oyo Zaakayo aliiri mukulu w'abafurhiisa b'amakooli. Aliiri muchire.
Agendaga ashonda kubona Yeesu ali nde. Aliko, elugulu w'abantu banene arhakamubwene bulaala aliiri muufu.
Alibirhira embere, anashona oku murhi g'omukuyu y'abona Yeesu, kwenge alikwaneene kulenga ahoola.
Yeesu abeere agera ahoola, ayinamula ameesho anamubwira ntya: «Zaakayo, shonooka juba; bulaala bimpemere ndyaame emwawe zeene.»
Zaakayo ashonooka juba, ayankirira Yeesu n'obushagaluke bunene.
Abantu booshi baabonaga ebyoola, balunduma n'okuderha ntya: «Mulolage! Oyu muntu ajiire kulyaama emw'omunyabyaaha!»
Aliko Zaakayo ayimanga, abwira Nnaweerhu ntya: «Nnaweerhu! Naaha abakene oluhande lw'ebintu byaani, n'akaba hali eyi nalengenye echintu chaage, namugalulira cho eyi nkubire cho kane.»
Yeesu amubwira ntya: «Zeene obuchunguke bwahikire mw'eyila nju, bulaala oyu naye ali mugala w'Abrahaamu.
Kwenge Mwene oMuntu ayinjire gushonda n'oguchungula abaherere.»
Omugani gwa baja ekumi
Abantu babeere bayunva ebyoola, bakengeera okw'obwime bwa Nnamahanga bukola kubonekana ho n'aho, bulaala Yeesu aliiri hoofu n'eYerusaleema. Aja ashuba kubachiira ogu mugani.
Aderha ntya: «Haliiri murhwali muguma wajaaga omu gihugo cha hale mpu aje kuyimikirwa yo, buzinda agaluke kuyima omu gihugo chaage.
Ahamagala bantu ekumi omu baja baage, abaha bicheri ekumi
n'okubabwira ntya: ‹Murhimbuule n'ezi furanga kugera amango nagaluka.›
Aliko abantu b'egihugo chaage babaaga bamugayire. Baarhuma abantu enyuma zaage kuderha ntya: ‹Rhurhashonda oyu muntu abe mwami weerhu.›
«Abeere ayimikirwe, agaluka, ahamagaza bala baja ahaaga efuranga, mpu amenye enyungu nchi babwene omu burhimbuuzi.
Omuja mwambere achimoleka n'okuderha ntya: ‹Waliha, egicheri chaawe chayungukire bindi ekumi.›
Mwami amubwira ntya: ‹Kooko, oli muja mwinja; bulaala orhabeere muhemusi omu bintu bigeeke, wagwarha oburhegesi oku bishagala ekumi.›
Omuja wakabiri ayinja n'okuderha ntya: ‹Waliha, egicheri chaawe chayungukire bindi birhaano.›
Mwami amubwira ntya: ‹Naawe waaba murhegesi wa bishagala birhaano.›
Owindi muja ayinja n'okuderha ntya: ‹Waliha, tala egicheri chaawe, nalichibiikire omu gitambara,
kwenge nali nkuyuubahire, bulaala oba muntu mudaarhi bweneene. Wooyo onarhoola eby'orhabiikaga, n'ogushaluula eby'orhahingaga.›
Mwami amubwira ntya: ‹Wooyo oli muja mubi, naguchiira olushinja gukulikirana n'ebinwa byaawe. Akaba waliyinji oku mba mudaarhi, oku ntoola ebi ntabiikaga n'oku nshaluula ebi ntahingaga,
bichi byarhumaga orhahira efuranga zaani omu banke? Omu kugaluka kwani, nakazirhoolere n'enyungu!›
Mwami aja abwira abantu baliiri ho ntya: ‹Mumunyage echo gicheri mugihe olaala ogwerhe bicheri ekumi.›
Babwira mwami ntya: ‹Waliha, oyoola akola agwerhe bicheri ekumi!›
Abashubiza ntya: ‹Mbabwirire oku ogwerhe akantu yi nji baheereza akandi, aliko orhagwerhe kantu nji bamunyaga n'ehintu hityuuli agwerhe.
N'bashombanyi baani boowe, barhalishondere oku mbe mwami waabo, mubaleerhe hano munabayirhire embere zaani.›»
Yeesu aja eYerusaleema
Yeesu abeere amala kuderha ntyo, aja embere z'abantu eyi bali bayeerekera eYerusaleema.
Abeere agera hoofu n'egishagala ch'eBetefaage n'eche Betaniiya, hoofu n'omusozi gw'eMizeyituuni, arhuma bigirizwa baage babiri,
ababwira ntya: «Muje omu gishagala chiri embere zenyu. Hano muchigera mo, mwashimaana omwana gw'epunda gushwekerwe, nta muntu oshubiraga yikala oku go. Mugishwekuule munachileerhe.
Nka hali omuntu obabazize ntya: ‹Gichi girhumire muli mwagishwekuula?› Mumushubize oku Nnaweerhu achilagire ko.»
Abo bigirizwa barhumwaga bagenda, banabugaana byooshi nk'oku Yeesu ababwiraga.
Babeere bali bashwekuula omwana gw'epunda, banyina go bababaza ntya: «Gichi girhumire muli mwashwekuula ogu mwana gw'epunda?»
Baashubiza ntya: «Nnaweerhu agulagire ko.»
Baja baguleerhera Yeesu. Baava baasasa ko emyambalo n'okumuyikaza ko.
Okw'ali agenda, abantu baalema baasasa emyambalo yaabo omu njira.

Yeesu abeere ali ayegeera hoofu n'omwandagalo gw'omusozi gw'eMizeyituuni, echigusho chooshi ch'abigirizwa baage, babaaga bali kugenda baamoga. Babaaga bali bakuuza Nnamahanga n'omulenge munene, elugulu w'ebisomereene byooshi bali babwene ko.
Baliiri kuderha ntya:
aBafarisaayo baguma, baliiri omu lubaga lw'abantu, babwira Yeesu ntya: «Mwigiriza, okalihire abigirizwa baawe basire.»
Yeesu abashubiza ntya: «Mbabwirire byo, bagasira, amabaale mo mayaama!»
Yeesu alakira egishagala ch'eYerusaleema
Amango Yeesu ageraga hoofu n'egishagala ch'eYerusaleema, abeere abona cho, alakira cho.
Aderha ntya: «Nka naawe wamenyaga zeene ebyagakuleerhera omurhuula! Aliko bunoola bibishirwe, orhakabibona.
Kwenge esiku zakuyinjira amango bashombanyi baawe bakuzirhira ko olugurhu, bakugorha n'okugufundeeza enyunda zooshi.
Baguhomboola looshi, wooyo n'abantu baawe. Barhagakulekera baale oku lindi, bulaala orhamenyaga egihe Nnamahanga ayinjaga gukulwira ko!»
Yeesu alibisya abarhimbuuzi omu Nju ya Nnamahanga
Yeesu abeere aja omu Nju ya Nnamahanga, arhondera kulibisya abarhimbuuzi.
Ava ababwira ntya: «Biyandikirwe: ‹Enju yaani nji yaaba nju y'amasaala.› Aliko mwabo mwayijirire lukunda lw'abeezi!»
Yeesu agendaga ayigiriza esiku zooshi omu Nju ya Nnamahanga. Abakulu b'abadaahwa, abigiriza b'amarhegeko n'abashamuka b'aBayaahudi balemaga bashonda kumuyirha.
Aliko bafundwa, bulaala abantu booshi baliiri bamuyunviriza bwinja buzira kuluha.
